Name: Issachar, Son of Obed-edom
Summary: Seventh son of Obed-edom the porter.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:5: Seventh son of Obed-edom the porter.
LifeLesson: The mention of Issachar in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
